description: A publish request whose body carries one well-formed anchors entry (a valid macp.commitment scheme, a valid content_hash shape) MUST be accepted: it passes schema validation, hash recomputation includes anchors byte-exactly, and signature verification succeeds normally. Anchors are ordinary producer-signed content — accepting them requires no new registry machinery beyond schema acceptance (RFC-ACDP-0016 §4, §5).

input.notes: content_hash and signature.value here are placeholders (as in pub-012's template) — this fixture pins acceptance of the anchors field's shape, not a full end-to-end signature golden (that is anc-004's job at the JCS/hash layer).

expected.response_shape: Standard publish response (RFC-ACDP-0003 §4): ctx_id, lineage_id, version, created_at, status.
post_publish_invariants: GET /contexts/{ctx_id} returns the body with anchors present, byte-identical to what was signed.
content_hash recomputed over the retrieved body (anchors included) matches the stored content_hash.
expected.rationale: A registry advertising acdp_version >= 0.5.0 MUST accept a well-formed anchors field exactly as it accepts any other schema-conformant optional field — anchors introduces no new validation step beyond the schema itself (RFC-ACDP-0016 §10).
